_comment: Pins for the Termux build. Everything here is a deliberate, reviewable
decision: bump one at a time and rebuild.
freebuff.ref is a git ref in the upstream repository. Pin a commit sha
rather than a branch for reproducible releases -- a branch moves, and an
OpenTUI API change upstream can break the build days later with no change
Must match the version Freebuff's cli/package.json pins after
ci/apply-config-delta.mjs runs; the CLI's build script asserts they are
Patched Bun that runs under Bionic. This is NOT stock Bun: upstream has
no Android build that works as-is (seccomp traps on fchmodat2/openat2,
no FFI JIT path). Pin an exact version -- never /latest, because a
regressed build reaching users is far worse than a missing one.
